chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Asbagh ibn Al-Asbagh, from Muhammad ibn Suleiman, from Marwan ibn Muslim, from Ubayd ibn Zurara or from Bureyd al-Ajaly (the doubt is from Muhammad), who said:

I said to Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him), 'If a slave woman commits adultery,' he said, 'She is whipped fifty.' I said, 'And if she repeats?' He said, 'She is whipped fifty.' I said, 'Is stoning obligatory upon her in any of the situations?' He said, 'If she commits adultery eight times, stoning is obligatory upon her.' I said, 'How did it become eight times?' He said, 'Because the free man, if he commits adultery four times and the Penalty is established upon him, he is killed. So when the slave woman commits adultery eight times, she is stoned in the ninth.'

I said, 'And what is the reason for that?' So he said, 'Allah has been Merciful to her that He would not gather upon her the rope of slavery and the Penalty of the free.' Then he said, 'And it is upon the Imam of the Muslims that he hand over her price to her master from the portion of the slaves.'

key_terms.الْحُرَّ: The free person (as opposed to a slave)
key_terms.سَهْمِ الرِّقَابِ: The portion of Khums allocated for freeing slaves

ai.seo_question: What is the difference in punishment for a slave woman versus a free man for repeated adultery in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi elucidates the jurisprudential principle of 'not combining the rope of slavery with the penalty of the free,' where the slave woman receives fifty lashes per offense until the eighth, followed by stoning in the ninth. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) explains this as divine mercy to avoid the compounded burden of servitude and capital punishment, with the master's financial loss compensated from the Imam's share of khums for manumission.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Asbagh Bin Asbagh, from Muhammad Bin Suleyman, from Marwan Bin Muslim, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara, or from Bureyd Al Ajaly, the doubt is, from Muhammad who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘A slave woman commits adultery’. Heasws said: ‘She would be whipped fifty’. I said, ‘So if she repeats?’ Heasws said: ‘She would be whipped fifty’. I said, ‘Would stoning be Obligated upon her from any of the situations?’ Heasws said: ‘If she were to commit adultery eight times, the stoning would be Obligated upon her’. I said, ‘How did it come to be eight times?’ Heasws said: ‘Because the free man when he commits adultery four times, and the Penalty (Hadd) is established upon him, he is killed. So when the slave woman commits adultery eight times, she would be stoned during the ninth’.

I said, ‘And what is the reason with regards to that?’ So heasws said: ‘Allahazwj has been Merciful to her that Heazwj would Gather upon her the rope of slavery and the Penalty (Hadd) of the free’. Then heasws said: ‘And it is upon the Imamasws of the Muslims that he hand over her price to her master from the portion of the slaves’.
